# Claw & Blade portraits used by this game

These 16 files are a small subset of "Claw & Blade - Medieval Game Assets" by
SPIRIT CLAW (https://spiritclaw.com/), renamed after the characters they portray in
El Índice de Ceniza. They are included as part of this game under the Spirit Claw Free
Asset License (LICENSE.txt). This folder is not an asset pack and must not be reused
as one: get the full pack from https://spirit-claw.itch.io/claw-and-blade .
